_note: Knobs for zone.py (ZoneParams) and drops.py (DropParams); partial overrides allowed, a bad file = defaults.

roof._note: roof.py: from start_s, climb a roof inside the next circle and hold it (stand back from the edges)

aggro._note: all-out aggression: fight anything within 230 m, flee only < 25% HP vs 2+, hunt the last known enemy instead of hiding

upgrade_ctx._note: pick upgrades by the weapon we hold and the weapons seen on enemies (Bot._upgrade_scores); off = fixed UPGRADE_PREF

weapon_ctx._note: weapon rank shifted by the weapon triangle vs weapons seen on enemies (Bot._ranks); off = fixed WEAPON_RANK

special_guard._note: no weapon swap that drops a held weapon while an enemy mech is within enemy_r or we were hit within quiet_s (Bot._take, Bot._in_fight)
